drivers: Four attributes to track simultaneously (count, shape, fill, rotation) with distractors varying each one
Count rule is a within-row +1 progression, but row 3 starts at a different value, which can mislead toward column constancy
Shape and fill follow familiar distribution-of-three rules that are easy to verify
Rotation is tied to shape (arrows always 180°), a subtle but consistent cue; 135° arrow options are plausible distractors
